GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 015 (25 Mar 46) LS
(SCAPIN-853)
APO 500
25 March 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : INPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT
THROUGH : Central Liaison office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Exercise of Criminal Jurisdiction.
1. Reference is made to Memorandum this Headquarters, file AG 015 (19
Feb. 46) LS, dated 19 February 1946, subject: "Exercise of Criminal Jurisdiction."
2. You are hereby notified that the authority vested in the Commander,
Fifth Fleet, referred to in paragraph 4 of the subject memorandum, has been
rescinded and is now vested in Commander, Naval Activities Japan.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH
Brigadier General, AGD,
Adjutant General.
